    About This Site 
    
    This portfolio was hand-built by me with no drag-and-drop builders.

     Tools I Used
    
      Quarto — for site structure and publishing
      HTML & CSS — for custom styling and layout
      R — for data visualizations and analytics work
    

     Why I Built It This Way
    For better or for worse, I pay attention to the details most people scroll past. Building it from scratch meant I could be deliberate about everything: the spacing, the tone, every pixel, every word. Every choice was intentional.
